meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: Claude 接手 migrate-v2.sh 跑完之后的部分：读 handoff.json 核对失败步骤，先确认 v2 能在真实频道收发消息，再授予 owner 角色、迁移旧记忆、核对容器配置，并协助搬运 v1 自定义代码。需要判断的地方会先展示再写入。
howto.when: 当你提到“migrate from v1”、“finish migration”等说法时触发。前提是 migrate-v2.sh 已跑完；若找不到 handoff.json，它会停下并让你先在终端运行该脚本。

say.text: 帮我确认 v2 能正常回消息，然后继续完成迁移
say.note: 它先做冒烟测试，再进入后续阶段

say.text: 把 owner 权限加到我的账号上
say.note: 它查 users 表后授予 owner 角色

say.text: 帮我迁移 v1 的旧记忆和容器配置

howto.what_en: Claude finishes the migration migrate-v2.sh started: reads handoff.json, checks failed steps, confirms v2 answers real messages, grants the owner role, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container config, and helps port v1 custom code. It shows changes before writing.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration" and similar phrases. Requires that migrate-v2.sh already ran; if handoff.json is missing it stops and tells you to run that script first, in your terminal.

say_en.text: Confirm v2 is answering messages, then continue the migration
say_en.note: It runs a smoke test before later phases

say_en.text: Grant the owner role to my account
say_en.note: It queries the users table and grants owner

say_en.text: Help me migrate v1 memory and container config
